reason: The mineral crystals appear suited to strengthening the collagen framework of the arm bones.
expectation: The mineral will reinforce the bone framework.

effect: The mineral reinforced the collagen framework, with the result distinguishing toughness from resistance to compression.
reaction: The contrast between collagen and mineral made their roles clearer.
reason: Bone cells appear to be the next component needed to make the mineralised framework living bone.
expectation: The bone cells will become part of the mineralised arm bones.

effect: The bone cells are now embedded in the mineralised framework, leaving blood vessels as the next apparent component of living bone.
reaction: The cutaway helps locate the cells within the bone.
reason: Blood vessels should supply the living bone cells.
expectation: The vessels will become part of the living arm bones.

effect: The vessels complete the living arm bones and show how embedded bone cells are supplied.
reaction: The connection between the vessels and bone cells is clear.
reason: Cartilage caps should provide smooth surfaces where the arm bones meet at the elbow.
expectation: The cartilage will cover the ends of the bones at the joint.

effect: The cartilage caps the facing elbow surfaces and provides surfaces that can slide against each other.
reaction: The inset makes the cartilage's role easy to picture.
reason: The synovial capsule appears suited to enclosing the joint and its fluid.
expectation: The capsule will enclose the elbow joint.

effect: The capsule encloses the joint, and its lining supplies fluid that helps the cartilage surfaces glide.
reaction: The result clarified what the fluid and lining contribute.
reason: The remaining ligaments span the elbow and should support the joint.
expectation: The ligaments will support the enclosed elbow and complete the arm skeleton.

effect: The ligaments completed the movable arm skeleton, showing how the elbow can bend while resisting sideways movement.
reaction: The final picture brought the joint's moving and supporting parts together clearly.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding mineral was most worthwhile because the result distinguished collagen's toughness from mineral's resistance to compression.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding bone cells was the least informative passage: the cutaway showed where they sit, but did not explain what they do.

surprise.text: I learned that the capsule's lining supplies fluid that helps the cartilage-covered surfaces glide.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the item descriptions suggested a purpose for each addition, though the sequence was quite predictable.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter to see how the skeleton connects to muscles, although I would hope for more meaningful choices than the mostly straightforward sequence here.
